entry.description: Keep logging to a deep path on Unix. The locks that serialise writing and rolling are named after the log file, and Unix rejects a name longer than 255 UTF-8 bytes, which a path of 104 characters can already exceed, so the appender failed to start and nothing was written at all. Such a name is hashed now; shorter ones, and every name on Windows, are unchanged (audit da18b6fd-f010, da18b6fd-f031, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
